feed.subtitle: Research papers and global crypto regulation, at a glance
feed.rights: Explanations and summaries are generated by AI from the original text. Dates, rates and amounts are checked against the source, but errors are still possible, so always rely on the original. Nothing here is legal, tax or investment advice.

entry.title: CFTC to hold a December 15 roundtable on 24/7 trading in derivatives markets
entry.summary: CFTC to Host Roundtable on 24/7 Trading CFTC · Oct 28, 2026 · Crypto The U.S. Commodity Futures Trading Commission announced an industry roundtable on December 15 to discuss whether derivatives markets can viably move to 24/7 trading. It builds on the CFTC's earlier summer Request for Comment on the topic. Discussion topics include overnight trading, tokenization, infrastructure, staffing, and operational readiness. The event will be held at CFTC headquarters in Washington and livestreamed on CFTC.gov.

entry.title: SFC hosts IOSCO committee meeting on issuer accounting, auditing and disclosure
entry.summary: SFC hosts meeting of IOSCO’s Committee on Issuer Accounting, Audit and Disclosure SFC · Oct 9, 2026 The Securities and Futures Commission hosted the plenary meeting of IOSCO's Committee on Issuer Accounting, Audit and Disclosure in Hong Kong from 5 to 8 October 2026. More than 35 representatives from 21 securities regulators discussed modernising disclosure requirements to reduce listed companies' reporting burdens, developments in financial reporting and auditing, and emerging issues such as technology, artificial intelligence and private equity investment in audit firms.

entry.title: Legal challenge to FCA motor finance compensation scheme to be heard in February 2027
entry.summary: Motor finance legal challenge to be heard in February 2027 FCA · Oct 13, 2026 The Upper Tribunal will hear legal challenges to the FCA's motor finance compensation scheme from 16 to 26 February 2027. The scheme is currently partially suspended, but firms must keep preparing and progressing complaints. The document also gives advice to lenders and consumers, including that consumers can complain directly to their lender for free and need not use a law firm or claims management company.

entry.title: SFC issues guidance on enhancing Hong Kong's retail fund regime ahead of revised UT Code taking effect 1 November 2026
entry.summary: SFC issues guidance to support enhancements to Hong Kong’s retail fund regime SFC · Oct 28, 2026 · Crypto The Securities and Futures Commission of Hong Kong published guidance to help the fund industry prepare for the revised Code on Unit Trusts and Mutual Funds, which takes effect on 1 November 2026. Key changes include a Value-at-Risk approach to managing funds' derivatives exposure, enhanced liquidity risk management, and stronger investment and disclosure requirements for money market funds. The SFC also published revised key facts statement templates for different fund types to improve transparency.

entry.title: SFC welcomes launch of Platform and Nominee Services on Integrated Fund Platform
entry.summary: SFC welcomes launch of Platform and Nominee Services on Integrated Fund Platform SFC · Oct 28, 2026 The Securities and Futures Commission welcomes HKEX's launch of Platform and Nominee Services on the Integrated Fund Platform (IFP). The launch marks a key milestone for the IFP. Distributors, including brokers, can now subscribe and redeem fund units on behalf of their clients, helping fund managers and distributors streamline operations.

entry.title: Keynote speech by SFC Chairman Kelvin Wong at IOSCO World Investor Week 2026 on strengthening investor judgement amid digital fraud
entry.summary: New speech by Kelvin Wong: Keynote Remarks at IOSCO World Investor Week 2026 - Strike the Gong for Financial Literacy Event SFC · Oct 14, 2026 Hong Kong SFC Chairman Dr Kelvin Wong delivered a keynote speech on 13 October 2026 at the IOSCO World Investor Week 2026 event, titled “Honing Investor Judgement in an Age of Digital Deception.” He notes that fraud now spreads through social media and instant messaging, that AI can create convincing impersonations, and that online investment scams account for most fraud losses in Hong Kong. He proposes three habits for investors, namely practise, pause and question, and says regulators, financial institutions and technology platforms also share responsibility.

entry.title: SFC approves six securities registrars ahead of uncertificated securities market regime
entry.summary: SFC approves six securities registrars for upcoming uncertificated securities market regime SFC · Oct 13, 2026 The SFC approved six companies as approved securities registrars, effective 16 November 2026 when the uncertificated securities market regime takes effect. Two of them were approved to provide USM-related services, and other applications will be considered later. Listing applicants whose securities are listed in uncertificated form after that date must appoint an ASR approved for USM services. Existing issuers must participate in the regime within five years.

entry.title: HK regulator strengthens tools for IPO and other corporate misconduct cases
entry.summary: SFC proceeds to strengthen targeted tools to tackle IPO-related and other corporate misconduct SFC · Oct 13, 2026 The Securities and Futures Commission has published its consultation conclusions and will proceed with amendments to the Securities and Futures (Stock Market Listing) Rules. The changes allow conditions on listing applicants that continue after listing, and post-listing conditions as an alternative to immediate trading suspension, with streamlined resumption procedures. A new independent merits review mechanism through the Securities and Futures Appeals Tribunal will also be introduced. The SFC expects the amendments to take effect in the first quarter of 2027, subject to the legislative process.

entry.title: Julia Leung's ASIFMA keynote on Hong Kong market liquidity and capital flows.
entry.summary: New speech by Julia Leung: Keynote address at ASIFMA’s Future of Liquidity in Asia Pacific Capital Markets Conference SFC · Oct 9, 2026 SFC Chief Executive Julia Leung delivered a keynote speech titled "Project Liquidity: Engineering the Market Plumbing that Unlocks Capital Flows for Hong Kong" at the ASIFMA Future of Liquidity in Asia Pacific Capital Markets Conference. The speech has been posted on the SFC website.

entry.title: SFC, AFRC and HKEX Joint Statement on Financial Statements with Disclaimers of Opinion Solely Relating to Going Concern
entry.summary: SFC, AFRC and the Exchange join forces to address disclaimers of opinion solely relating to going concern SFC · Oct 9, 2026 The SFC, AFRC and Hong Kong Exchange issued a joint statement addressing rising concern over listed issuers publishing financial statements with a disclaimer of audit opinion solely related to going concern. The statement sets out expectations for management, audit committees and auditors regarding going concern assessments, aiming to improve reporting quality and investor confidence. It also states that the Exchange may amend the Listing Rules, including requiring suspension of such issuers, if no significant improvement is seen.

entry.title: Hong Kong regulator to implement retail fund rule enhancements
entry.summary: SFC to proceed with enhancements to Hong Kong’s retail fund regime code SFC · Oct 8, 2026 The Securities and Futures Commission will implement changes to strengthen the rules for SFC-authorised retail funds, taking effect in November 2026. The revisions to the Code on Unit Trusts and Mutual Funds introduce a Value-at-Risk approach for derivative exposure management, streamline requirements for management companies and feeder funds, and improve liquidity risk management and money market fund safeguards. Four related codes will be revised consequentially, with a 12-month transitional period for existing funds.

entry.title: Hong Kong securities brokers post strong earnings growth in first half of 2026
entry.summary: Hong Kong’s securities brokers post strong earnings growth in first half of 2026 SFC · Oct 7, 2026 The SFC's financial review of the securities industry reports that net profit rose 21% to $51.7 billion in the first half of 2026. Total transaction value reached a record $149.0 trillion, and active clients increased 10% to about 5.7 million. Higher trading commission and interest income offset a drop in asset management-related fees, leaving total revenue broadly stable.

entry.title: Hong Kong and Malaysia regulators launch single submission arrangement to simplify simultaneous listings
entry.summary: SFC, Securities Commission Malaysia announce Single Submission Arrangement to streamline simultaneous listings in Malaysia and Hong Kong SFC · Oct 1, 2026 The SFC and Securities Commission Malaysia unveiled simplified procedures letting companies list simultaneously in Hong Kong and Malaysia. Applicants need only one listing application and one listing document to meet both markets' requirements. The arrangement aims to reduce duplicated regulatory work and compliance costs at the IPO stage. Both regulators have set up dedicated review teams and coordinated review processes.

entry.title: SFC reprimands and fines Zheng Da $7 million, suspends its responsible officer for seven months
entry.summary: SFC reprimands and fines Zheng Da International Financial Holding Limited $7 million and suspends its responsible officer for regulatory breaches SFC · Sep 29, 2026 The Hong Kong Securities and Futures Commission reprimanded and fined Zheng Da International Financial Holding Limited $7 million for anti-money laundering and other regulatory failures between 1 December 2021 and 30 September 2023. The SFC found the firm conducted no due diligence or testing on customer supplied systems used by 160 clients and failed to properly monitor deposits and suspicious trading in eight client accounts. The SFC also suspended the licence of responsible officer Zhong Hao for seven months from 28 September 2026 to 27 April 2027.

entry.title: SFC updates industry on scam prevention and cybersecurity
entry.summary: SFC shares updates with securities industry on scam prevention and cybersecurity SFC · Sep 29, 2026 The Securities and Futures Commission hosted a Brokers’ Forum for over 600 industry participants on defending businesses against scams. The forum shared the latest supervisory observations and regulatory updates on cybersecurity and anti-scam measures. Speakers included representatives from the SFC, Hong Kong Police and the Investor and Financial Education Council, and the forum aims to strengthen information sharing with the industry.

entry.title: SFC and AFRC sign new MoU extending financial reporting oversight to licensed firms and funds
entry.summary: SFC and AFRC extend regulatory cooperation to financial reporting of licensed firms and funds under new MoU SFC · Sep 28, 2026 · Crypto The Securities and Futures Commission and the Accounting and Financial Reporting Council signed a new Memorandum of Understanding expanding their cooperation beyond listed entities. It covers financial and compliance reporting by licensed corporations, licensed virtual asset service providers, SFC-authorised funds and registered open-ended fund companies, along with related audit and assurance work. The MoU also sets out a framework for information sharing, case referrals, mutual assistance and coordinated inspections, and supersedes the 2021 MoU.

entry.title: Speech by SFC Chairman Kelvin Wong at the SFC–AFRC MoU signing ceremony
entry.summary: New speech by Kelvin Wong: Remarks at SFC and Accounting and Financial Reporting Council’s MoU Signing Ceremony SFC · Sep 28, 2026 SFC Chairman Kelvin Wong gave remarks at the signing of a modernised memorandum of understanding between the SFC and the Accounting and Financial Reporting Council. The speech, titled “Enhanced SFC-AFRC Partnership: A Living Framework to Bolster Market Confidence,” traces the partnership back to 2007 and identifies financial reporting and audit oversight as the intersection of the two regulators' mandates. It emphasises that sharing intelligence and expertise supports investor protection and market confidence.

entry.title: SFC acts against suspected IPO-rigging groups and suspends Baicha share trading
entry.summary: SFC takes action against suspected IPO-rigging syndicates and suspends dealings in Baicha shares SFC · Oct 13, 2026 The Hong Kong SFC has taken action against two groups suspected of fraudulently creating false demand for IPO shares and directed the SEHK to suspend trading in Sichuan Baicha Baidao Industrial shares. Restriction notices were issued to six brokers covering assets linked to Ms Sun Ran and eight related companies, and to 29 brokers covering assets linked to three entities. The investigations are continuing.

entry.title: Hong Kong SFC notes sponsor improvements but urges continued vigilance
entry.summary: SFC recognises progress in sponsors’ work and urges sustained vigilance SFC · Oct 13, 2026 The SFC says sponsors' resources and principal capacity have improved since January 2026, with sponsor work more widely spread across the market. It notes that deficiencies persist in some listing applications and has identified serious concerns over dubious arrangements in certain IPOs. The circular asks sponsors and other gatekeepers to step up monitoring of potential red flags.

entry.title: Kelvin Wong's speech at IFAPC 25th anniversary and 2026 Outstanding Listed Companies Award: how analysts can enhance market quality and competitiveness
entry.summary: New speech by Kelvin Wong: Remarks at the IFAPC’s 25th anniversary and Outstanding Listed Companies Award 2026 SFC · Oct 16, 2026 SFC Chairman Dr Kelvin Wong delivered a speech on 16 October 2026 at the 25th anniversary and award ceremony of the Hong Kong Institute of Financial Analysts and Professional Commentators Limited, titled "Shaping the Future with Professionalism and Trust." He argued that analysts build market trust through research depth, independent judgment and ongoing scrutiny. The speech stresses that regulators, listed companies and analysts each play a role in improving Hong Kong's market quality.

entry.title: SFC welcomes HKEX proposal to move Hong Kong stock settlement to T+1
entry.summary: SFC welcomes HKEX’s proposal to implement T+1 settlement in Hong Kong’s stock market SFC · Oct 16, 2026 The Securities and Futures Commission welcomed HKEX's consultation conclusions, issued on 16 October 2026, on moving Hong Kong's cash stock market from T+2 to T+1 settlement. The implementation timeline has been revised to the second half of 2028, with September 2028 as the target date. The SFC said it will work with HKEX on the required rule amendments and implementation arrangements.

entry.title: SFC welcomes re-appointment of non-executive directors for two more years
entry.summary: SFC welcomes re-appointment of Non-Executive Directors SFC · Oct 16, 2026 The Hong Kong Securities and Futures Commission welcomed the Financial Secretary's re-appointment of Keith Pogson and Chew Fook-aun as Non-Executive Directors. Their new two-year terms start on 20 October 2026 and 1 January 2027, respectively. SFC Chairman Dr Kelvin Wong said their experience and judgement have greatly contributed to the Board's work and the SFC's governance.

entry.title: SFC brings market misconduct case over alleged share price manipulation linked to GEM-to-Main Board transfer plan
entry.summary: SFC commences MMT proceedings against GEM-listed Taste•Gourmet’s top executives and associates over alleged manipulation scheme for Main Board transfer SFC · Oct 22, 2026 The Securities and Futures Commission has started Market Misconduct Tribunal proceedings against three top executives of GEM-listed Taste•Gourmet and five relatives, employees and associates over an alleged scheme to manipulate the share price from June to September 2020. The alleged aim was to meet the minimum market capitalisation needed for a transfer to the Main Board. The tribunal will determine whether market misconduct occurred and who was involved.

entry.title: SFC approves first-ever secondary trading of tokenised public funds
entry.summary: SFC approves first-ever secondary trading of tokenised public funds SFC · Oct 26, 2026 · Crypto The Hong Kong Securities and Futures Commission has approved the world's first secondary trading of tokenised public funds on an SFC-licensed virtual asset trading platform. Two existing SFC-authorised tokenised money market funds can now be traded around the clock. The SFC introduced a framework in April 2026 setting requirements for trading channel operation, fair pricing, liquidity provision and disclosure.

entry.title: ADGM Publishes Guidance on Crypto Mining Activities
entry.summary: ADGM Becomes the Region's First International Financial Centre to Publish Dedicated Crypto Mining Guidance ADGM / FSRA · Oct 28, 2026 · Crypto The Registration Authority of ADGM has published guidance on crypto mining activities within or from the centre. Issued under the Commercial Licensing Regulations 2025, it treats crypto mining as a licensable commercial activity rather than a regulated financial service. The technology-neutral guidance covers Proof-of-Work, Proof-of-Stake and future consensus mechanisms. It is the first phase of the authority's approach, with a regulatory framework to be developed and consulted on later.

entry.title: NCUA Seeks Public Comment on Draft 2027–2028 Budget
entry.summary: NCUA Draft 2027-2028 Budget Federal Register · Oct 28, 2026 · Crypto The National Credit Union Administration published its draft detailed business-type budget for fiscal years 2027 and 2028 for public review, as required by federal statute. The draft covers three components: the Operating Budget, the Capital Budget, and the Share Insurance Fund Administrative Budget. Public comments may be submitted through regulations.gov under docket NCUA–2026–2146 by November 30, 2026, and in-person statements may be presented at a November 17, 2026 budget hearing.

entry.title: VARA Circular on Good Practice for VASP Public Disclosures
entry.summary: Circular: Good practices for VASP’s public disclosures VARA · Oct 28, 2026 · Crypto VARA issued a circular describing good-practice characteristics for public disclosures by licensed Virtual Asset Service Providers, based on its thematic review. It states that disclosure compliance should be an ongoing obligation requiring governance, monitoring and periodic testing rather than a one-time licensing task. The circular is illustrative only and does not modify any Regulations or Rulebooks.

entry.title: Notice of a symposium co-hosted by the FSA and Hitotsubashi University (December 10, 2026)
entry.summary: 金融庁・一橋大学による共催シンポジウムの開催について（令和８年12月10日）公表しました。 金融庁 · Oct 28, 2026 The Financial Services Agency and Hitotsubashi University will co-host a symposium on December 10, 2026, at Hitotsubashi Hall in Tokyo. Themes are regional economic revitalization and finance, and corporate value enhancement and Japanese corporate management. The program includes FSA presentations, practitioner lectures, and a panel discussion with university researchers, open to the public by advance registration and conducted in Japanese.

entry.title: FSA posts agenda for third meeting of Business Accounting Council's sustainability assurance subcommittee on third-party assurance standards
entry.summary: 企業会計審議会第３回サステナビリティ情報保証部会の議事次第について公表しました。 金融庁 · Oct 28, 2026 · Crypto The Financial Services Agency published the agenda and materials for the third meeting of the Business Accounting Council's Sustainability Information Assurance Subcommittee, scheduled for October 29, 2026. The secretariat's briefing material is a draft opinion on standards for assurance services, quality management, and ethics and independence for sustainability information. It explains the background, the purpose of third-party assurance, and the proposed nature and names of the standards.

entry.title: ADGM Regulator Fines MCA Auditors and Audit Principal USD 88,000 Over Audit Failings
entry.summary: ADGM’s RA Imposes Financial Penalties of USD 88,000 Against MCA Auditors and its Registered Audit Principal for Audit Failings 23 Oct 2026 ADGM / FSRA · Oct 23, 2026 The ADGM Registration Authority (RA) imposed financial penalties totalling USD 88,000 on MCA Auditors and Advisors LLP and its Audit Principal following an on-site inspection that found audit deficiencies. The findings covered risk assessment, fraud risk, group audit requirements, governance communications, and insufficient evidence over material areas. The RA considered cooperation and the firm's root-cause analysis and remediation plan when setting the penalties.

entry.title: FSA recruits a lawyer for monitoring of crypto and fund transfer business compliance
entry.summary: 採用,職員を募集しています。（金融モニタリング業務（資金移動業者や暗号資産交換業者等の法令等遵守態勢、関連法令の解釈等）に従事する職員) 金融庁 · Oct 28, 2026 · Crypto The Financial Services Agency announced on October 28, 2026 a recruitment for one lawyer as a fixed-term national civil servant. The role covers monitoring legal compliance of crypto asset exchange and fund transfer businesses, legal interpretation, and developing guidelines. Employment is expected from around January 2027 for about two years, selected by document screening and interview.

entry.title: Basel Committee publishes AML/CFT supervisory newsletter
entry.summary: 国際関係,バーゼル銀行監督委員会による「AML/CFTに関する監督ニューズレター」について公表しました。 金融庁 · Oct 28, 2026 On 19 October, the Basel Committee on Banking Supervision published an AML/CFT supervisory newsletter. It summarizes a survey on supervisors' data collection and risk assessment methods for AML/CFT risk assessment, and the outcomes of a workshop on the role of AI and machine learning in transaction monitoring.

entry.title: FSA visit schedule for 2026 experienced-hire exam (Section Chief level, administrative, joint ministries Category B)

Reservable visits are set for December 8 to 10, 2026, mainly in person, with online interviews available for applicants living far away. Bookings are made by email from December 4 to 12:00 on December 9.

entry.title: CFTC and Kansas State University co-host AgCon 2026 agricultural futures conference in Kansas
entry.summary: ICYMI: Agricultural Leaders and Market Participants Join CFTC Chairman Selig in Overland Park, Kansas for AgCon 2026 CFTC · Oct 27, 2026 · Crypto The CFTC and Kansas State University's Risk Management Center co-hosted the two-day 2026 Agricultural Commodity Futures Conference (AgCon) in Overland Park, Kansas. Panels covered the agricultural economy, derivatives market developments, farm credit, and risk management tools for producers. Topics included perpetual futures, 24/7 trading, and tokenized collateral. CFTC Chairman Michael S. Selig attended and delivered the closing remarks.

entry.title: CFTC Sues Utah to Stop State Enforcement Against Regulated Markets
entry.summary: CFTC Sues to Block State Enforcement in Utah Amid Ongoing Efforts to Preserve Jurisdiction CFTC · Oct 27, 2026 The Commodity Futures Trading Commission (CFTC) has sued Utah to block the state from using state laws to shut down CFTC-registered contract markets. Utah had earlier filed civil enforcement actions in state court against CFTC-regulated markets and other businesses. The CFTC says Congress gave it exclusive federal jurisdiction over commodity derivatives, including event contracts, and that it has also started legal proceedings against nine other states.

entry.title: CFTC to Publish Commitments of Traders Report Twice Weekly
entry.summary: CFTC Announces Semiweekly Publication of the COT Report CFTC · Oct 27, 2026 The U.S. Commodity Futures Trading Commission (CFTC) plans to increase publication of its Commitments of Traders (COT) Report from once to twice a week by the end of 2026. Monday data will be released Wednesday and Wednesday data Friday, both at 3:30 p.m. ET, cutting reporting latency from three days to two. The change follows a Request for Comment and aims to give agricultural market participants more timely trading position information.

entry.title: SEC Sues TSAI Pro Ltd. and TSAI Capital Foundation Over Fake AI Trading Bot Scheme
entry.summary: SEC Charges Multiple Entities in Fraud Schemes Totaling at Least $15 Million That Used WhatsApp and Other Platforms to Lure Investors SEC · Sep 29, 2026 · Crypto The SEC filed a complaint against TSAI Pro Ltd. and TSAI Capital Foundation, alleging they promoted an AI trading bot program promising guaranteed profits via their website, WhatsApp groups and Facebook. The complaint says no AI trading bots existed and deposited funds were never used to generate returns for investors. The defendants also falsely claimed SEC regulation and displayed a phony SEC certificate and falsified Form D.

entry.title: Bullseye Financial Ltd enters administration
entry.summary: Bullseye Financial Ltd enters administration FCA · Oct 27, 2026 Bullseye Financial Ltd entered administration on 23 October 2026, with Robert Young of Azets Holdings Limited and Matthew Haw of RSM UK Restructuring Advisory LLP appointed as joint administrators. The FCA-authorised firm served only professional investors and agreed on 11 March 2026 to stop carrying out any regulated activity. The notice provides contact details for customers and warns about fraudsters posing as the firm or its administrators.

entry.title: CFTC Obtains Court Order Requiring Louisiana Man and Companies to Pay Over $9 Million in Forex Fraud
entry.summary: CFTC Secures Court Order Directing Louisiana Man and His Companies to Pay Over $9 Million in Forex Fraud CFTC · Oct 21, 2026 The Commodity Futures Trading Commission announced that the U.S. District Court for the Eastern District of Louisiana entered a default judgment against Michael B. DePetrillo, Meteor LLC, and NOLA FX Capital Management LLC. The court found they fraudulently solicited and misappropriated over $3 million from participants in a retail forex scheme. The order requires a $9,211,492 civil penalty, permanently enjoins further Commodity Exchange Act violations, and imposes permanent trading and registration bans.

entry.title: Japan FSA Issues Amendment to Designated Accounting Standards Notice and Publishes Public Comment Results
entry.summary: 「連結財務諸表の用語、様式及び作成方法に関する規則に規定する金融庁長官が定める企業会計の基準を指定する件の一部を改正する件」の公布及びパブリックコメントの結果の公表 金融庁 · Sep 29, 2026 The Financial Services Agency promulgated an amendment to the notice designating accounting standards under the Regulation on Terminology, Forms and Preparation Methods of Consolidated Financial Statements, and published the results of public comments, which received two submissions. The amendment removes IFRS 14 Regulatory Deferral Accounts, adds IFRS 20 Regulatory Assets and Regulatory Liabilities, and reflects an amendment to IAS 28. It takes effect on the date of promulgation.

entry.title: Financial measures for disasters from Typhoon No. 18 of Reiwa 8 (Kagoshima Prefecture)
entry.summary: 令和８年台風第18号に伴う災害等に対する金融上の措置（鹿児島県） 金融庁 · Sep 30, 2026 On September 30, 2026, Japan's Financial Services Agency announced that the Kyushu Finance Bureau requested financial measures in response to disasters caused by Typhoon No. 18 of Reiwa 8. The announcement concerns this request for financial relief.

entry.title: Financial measures for disasters from Typhoon No. 25 of Reiwa 8 (Kanagawa Prefecture)
entry.summary: 令和８年台風第25号に伴う災害等に対する金融上の措置（神奈川県） 金融庁 · Oct 1, 2026 The Financial Services Agency published a press release stating that the Kanto Local Finance Bureau requested financial measures for disasters related to Typhoon No. 25 of Reiwa 8 in Kanagawa Prefecture. The release includes links to the Kanto Local Finance Bureau's notice and contact information.

entry.title: Agenda published for the 2nd meeting of the Financial System Council’s working group on funding for growth companies
entry.summary: 金融審議会「成長企業への資金供給の在り方等に関するワーキング・グループ」（第２回）議事次第の公表 金融庁 · Oct 8, 2026 The Financial Services Agency published the agenda and materials for the second meeting of the Financial System Council working group on funding for growth companies, held on October 9, 2026. The meeting included presentations from the Japan Private Equity Association, the FSA secretariat and the Fintech Association, along with an opinion paper from a member. The materials focus on loosening rules for “professional” lending to large companies engaged in business restructuring.

entry.title: Announcement of the 25th Financial Services Agency–Bank of Japan Liaison Meeting
entry.summary: 第25回「金融庁・日本銀行連絡会」の開催の公表 金融庁 · Oct 9, 2026 The Financial Services Agency and the Bank of Japan announced they held the 25th FSA–BOJ Liaison Meeting to exchange views on conditions in financial systems and financial markets. Members included the FSA Commissioner and the BOJ Deputy Governor.

entry.title: CFTC and NBA Sign MOU to Protect Basketball Integrity in Prediction Markets
entry.summary: CFTC and National Basketball Association Sign MOU to Protect Integrity in Professional Basketball CFTC · Oct 26, 2026 The Commodity Futures Trading Commission and the National Basketball Association signed a Memorandum of Understanding to protect the integrity of professional basketball in prediction markets. Under the MOU, the two parties will share information by regularly communicating about integrity matters and maintaining fair and transparent prediction markets. CFTC Chairman Michael S. Selig said the agreement continues the Commission's commitment to expanding data sharing with professional sports leagues.

entry.title: IRS gives new relief to taxpayers hit by Israel conflict, with some filing and payment deadlines postponed to Sept. 30, 2027
entry.summary: IRS announces new relief for eligible taxpayers affected by ongoing events in Israel: due dates for eligible returns and payments may be postponed to Sept. 30, 2027; additional relief may be available IRS · Sep 30, 2026 The IRS announced that, because of the ongoing conflict in Israel, a wide range of federal tax filing, payment and other time-sensitive deadlines are postponed until Sept. 30, 2027. Affected individuals and businesses in Israel, the West Bank and Gaza are covered. The notice builds on earlier relief notices, and eligible taxpayers outside the covered area can request relief through the IRS disaster hotline.

entry.title: SEC Charges Zoe Financial for Undisclosed Conflicts of Interest in Adviser Referrals
entry.summary: SEC Charges Registered Investment Adviser Zoe Financial for Failure to Disclose Conflict of Interest SEC · Sep 29, 2026 The SEC settled charges against New York-based registered investment adviser Zoe Financial for failing to fully and fairly disclose material conflicts of interest to clients. The order finds that from about January 2023 to December 2024, the firm did not disclose its financial incentive to refer clients to third-party advisers using its Zoe Wealth platform, and misleadingly described how it mitigated other referral conflicts. Without admitting the findings, Zoe Financial agreed to a cease-and-desist order, a censure, and a $450,000 civil penalty.

entry.title: SEC Sues Meyer Global Management and CEO Over Alleged Fraud Against Retail Investors in Funds Holding SpaceX and Other Pre-IPO Shares
entry.summary: SEC Charges Meyer Global Management and Its CEO With Defrauding Retail Investors in Private Funds That Held Interests in SpaceX and Other Pre-IPO Securities SEC · Oct 1, 2026 The SEC filed a civil complaint against investment adviser Meyer Global Management LLC and its CEO, Owen E. H. Meyer. It alleges that from December 2021 onward, they misused client fund assets and deceived investors in private funds holding pre-IPO securities such as SpaceX. The SEC seeks permanent injunctions, disgorgement with prejudgment interest, and civil penalties.

entry.title: SEC Exam Division Publishes New Examination Handbook
entry.summary: SEC’s Division of Examinations Announces New Exam Handbook SEC · Oct 2, 2026 The SEC's Division of Examinations has published a new handbook, "The SEC Exam Handbook: A Practical Guide on Process and Engagement," replacing and expanding the previous examination brochure. It explains each stage of an examination, from risk assessment through the disposition letter, and outlines ways for registrants to give feedback or ask questions. The handbook also offers practical tips for exam preparation and compliance.

entry.title: Fee schedule amendment updating the definition of “trading platform” (Cboe EDGX, SR-CboeEDGX-2026-072)
entry.summary: Self-Regulatory Organizations; Cboe EDGX Exchange, Inc.; Notice of Filing and Immediate Effectiveness of a Proposed Rule Change To Amend Its Fee Schedule To Update the Definition of Trading Platform Federal Register · Oct 26, 2026 · Crypto The SEC published a notice of a proposed rule change filed by Cboe EDGX Exchange to amend its fee schedule and update the definition of “trading platform.” The filing was made on October 19, 2026, and is effective upon filing under Rule 19b-4(f)(2). The notice invites public comments, to be submitted on or before November 16, 2026.

entry.title: Federal Reserve proposes application procedures for bank subsidiaries seeking approval to issue payment stablecoins
entry.summary: Application Procedures for Board-Supervised Insured Depository Institutions Seeking Approval for a Subsidiary To Issue Payment Stablecoins Federal Register · Sep 29, 2026 · Crypto The Federal Reserve Board proposes rules under the GENIUS Act establishing procedures for insured state member banks to seek Board approval for a subsidiary to issue payment stablecoins. The proposal would be added as Subpart D to Regulation UU in 12 CFR part 247 and defines "payment stablecoin" consistent with the Act. Comments are due November 30, 2026.

entry.title: Proposed rule barring fund transfers involving A7 network sub-agents

entry.title: Financial planning firm IMFP and its representative IMA enter administration

entry.title: UK regulator secures repayment for crypto fraud victims
entry.summary: FCA secures money back for victims of crypto fraud FCA · Sep 28, 2026 · Crypto The FCA obtained confiscation orders against Raymondip Bedi and Patrick Mavanga, who ran a fake cryptoasset investment scheme that defrauded at least 65 investors of £1,541,799. On 28 September 2026, Bedi was ordered to pay £603,404.28 and Mavanga £247,997.99. The FCA says funds recovered through the process will be returned to victims.

entry.title: Revision of the FSA Q&A on Personal Information Protection for Financial Institutions
entry.summary: 「金融機関における個人情報保護に関するQ&A」の改正の公表 金融庁 · Sep 28, 2026 The Financial Services Agency announced a revision to its Q&A on personal information protection for financial institutions. Following an amendment to the inter-ministry agreement on cyberattack incident reporting, a new common form for other cyberattack incidents was introduced, and the revised Q&A clarifies that this form may be used to report personal data leaks. The revised Q&A applies from October 1, 2026.

entry.title: FSA announces support decision for a proof-of-concept under its FinTech PoC Hub and Payment Innovation Project (PIP)
entry.summary: 「FinTech実証実験ハブ・決済高度化プロジェクト（PIP）」支援決定案件の公表 金融庁 · Sep 29, 2026 · Crypto On September 29, 2026, the Financial Services Agency (FSA) announced it has decided to support a proof-of-concept project under the PIP, the fourth such case in that program. After completion, the FSA plans to publish the results and conclusions on its website.

entry.title: Minutes of the 34th Financial Function Enhancement Review Board: reviewing the reorganization plan for Niigata Ken Credit Cooperative and Kouei Credit Cooperative
entry.summary: 第34回金融機能強化審査会 議事要旨 金融庁 · Sep 29, 2026 At the 34th Financial Function Enhancement Review Board meeting on September 2, 2026, the board reviewed the reorganization plan for Niigata Ken Credit Cooperative and Kouei Credit Cooperative. The two institutions explained their post-merger sales and branch strategies. Members commented on revenue structure, balancing branches against costs, responding to medium-term environmental changes, and managing sales of financial products. The board approved the plan.

entry.title: Approval of Reorganization Implementation Plan for Niigata-ken Shinyo and Kouei Credit Cooperatives
entry.summary: 新潟縣信用組合・興栄信用組合の組織再編成等実施計画の認定 金融庁 · Sep 29, 2026 Japan's Financial Services Agency announced it has reviewed and approved the reorganization implementation plan submitted by Niigata-ken Shinyo Credit Cooperative and Kouei Credit Cooperative under a capital injection program. The plan states the two cooperatives intend to merge around November 24, 2026, to continue providing basic financial services in Niigata Prefecture.

entry.title: ESMA Sets 2027 Priorities to Strengthen, Simplify and Integrate EU Capital Markets
entry.summary: ESMA sets 2027 priorities for stronger, simpler and more integrated EU capital markets ESMA · Sep 28, 2026 · Crypto The European Securities and Markets Authority (ESMA), the EU financial markets regulator, published its 2027 Annual Work Programme on 28 September 2026. Guided by its 2023–2028 strategy, the programme shifts several major initiatives from preparation to delivery. Key areas include simplifying regulatory and reporting frameworks, expanding supervisory mandates such as for ESG rating providers, and greater use of data and technology in supervision.

entry.title: Former Hubei CSRC Bureau Party Secretary and Director Wang Guangyou Expelled from the Party
entry.summary: 湖北证监局原党委书记、局长王广幼被开除党籍 中国证监会 · Sep 28, 2026 The CCDI supervision team stationed at the China Securities Regulatory Commission and the Hubei Supervisory Commission conducted a disciplinary review and supervisory investigation into Wang Guangyou, former party secretary and director of the Hubei CSRC bureau. The findings included serious violations of the central eight-point frugality rules, accepting gifts and cash, improperly borrowing large sums, and trading stocks, with suspicion of bribery. The CSRC party committee decided to expel him from the Party and confiscate illegal gains, and his suspected criminal case has been transferred to prosecutors for review and indictment.

entry.title: Treasury and IRS propose rules for installment payment of tax on certain farmland sales
entry.summary: Treasury, IRS issue proposed regulations on installment payments for tax on certain farmland sales IRS · Sep 28, 2026 The Treasury and IRS issued proposed regulations for taxpayers who sell or exchange qualifying farmland to qualified farmers and elect to pay the tax on the gain in four equal annual installments. The election, under Section 1062 of the Internal Revenue Code, applies to qualified transactions in taxable years beginning after July 4, 2025. The proposal also covers partnerships, S corporations, trusts and estates, and comments are requested by November 30, 2026.

entry.title: Reconsideration of gasoline facility air pollution standards (proposed rule)
entry.summary: National Emission Standards for Hazardous Air Pollutants for Gasoline Distribution Facilities and Standards of Performance for Bulk Gasoline Terminals Reconsideration Federal Register · Sep 28, 2026 The EPA proposes to reconsider parts of its 2024 final rule on hazardous air pollutant emissions from gasoline distribution facilities and bulk gasoline terminals. Topics include operating limits and continuous compliance for control devices, vapor tightness for gasoline cargo tanks, and modification criteria in the performance standards, along with technical corrections. The EPA states the changes do not alter the stringency of the standards and do not expect an impact on VOC or HAP emissions. Comments are due November 12, 2026.

entry.title: Federal Reserve proposal to implement its GENIUS Act duties for stablecoin issuers
entry.summary: Implementing the Federal Reserve Board's Responsibilities Under the GENIUS Act Federal Register · Sep 29, 2026 · Crypto The Federal Reserve Board proposes rules to implement the GENIUS Act for permitted payment stablecoin issuers it supervises and certain other entities under its jurisdiction. It also proposes rules implementing the Act's tying prohibition, which applies to all permitted payment stablecoin issuers. The proposal covers topics such as reserve assets, redemption, risk management, capital, and custodians. Comments are due by November 30, 2026.

entry.title: HKSAR Government's fourth digital green bond offering
entry.summary: HKSAR Government’s Fourth Digital Green Bonds Offering HKMA · Sep 29, 2026 · Crypto The Hong Kong SAR Government priced about HK$20 billion of digital green bonds in HKD, RMB, USD and EUR under its Government Sustainable Bond Programme. Subscription ratios across the four currencies ranged from 1.3 to 11.3 times. The HKD tranche settled using tokenised deposits, and the issuance adopted the ICMA Bond Data Taxonomy version 2.01.

entry.title: HKMA and Bank Negara Malaysia Strengthen Bilateral Cooperation
entry.summary: Hong Kong Monetary Authority and Bank Negara Malaysia Strengthen Bilateral Cooperation HKMA · Oct 6, 2026 · Crypto The HKMA and Bank Negara Malaysia held a high-level bilateral meeting in Hong Kong on 2 October, exchanging views on macroeconomic and financial developments, banking regulation, fintech, and capital market connectivity. The two institutions agreed to strengthen collaboration on fintech and digital assets, cross-border regulation, local currency usage and infrastructure linkages, and capital market connectivity.

entry.title: CFTC Wins Court Order Requiring Louisiana Man and Arkansas Woman to Pay Over $31 Million in Crypto and Precious Metals Fraud
entry.summary: CFTC Secures Court Order Directing Louisiana Man and Arkansas Woman to Pay Over $31 Million for Digital Assets, Precious Metals Fraud CFTC · Sep 30, 2026 The CFTC announced that the U.S. District Court for the Middle District of Florida entered a default judgment against Brian Early and Alisha Ann Kingrey for a digital assets and precious metals fraud involving the Fundsz entity and its website. The court also entered consent orders against Rachel Larralde, as personal representative of Rene Larralde's estate, and Juan Pablo Valcarce. Early and Kingrey were ordered to pay $15,732,455 in restitution and a $15,752,455 civil monetary penalty, plus permanent injunctions and registration and trading bans.

entry.title: FCA Survey: Firms' Satisfaction, Confidence and Trust in the Regulator Rise
entry.summary: Firms’ confidence, satisfaction and trust in the FCA rise FCA · Oct 2, 2026 The FCA and Practitioner Panel's 2026 annual survey of regulated firms found that 79% are highly satisfied with their relationship with the FCA, up from 74%. Firms also rated the FCA as highly effective more often, and 88% said they understand what the FCA expects under the Consumer Duty. Firms still want progress on regulatory burden, and the FCA says it is simplifying data requests.

entry.title: FCA appoints new Board members including two non-executive directors and deputy chief executive
entry.summary: FCA announces new Board appointments FCA · Sep 30, 2026 The UK Financial Conduct Authority has appointed Lea Paterson CBE and Matthew Tobin as non-executive directors, with the Treasury making the appointments. Deputy chief executive Sarah Pritchard has also joined the Board as an executive member. The new Board roles take effect on 1 October 2026.

entry.title: FCA opens applications for regulated crypto firms in the UK
entry.summary: FCA opens the gateway to regulated crypto FCA · Sep 30, 2026 · Crypto From today, crypto firms can apply to the Financial Conduct Authority (FCA) for authorisation. Crypto firms operating in the UK will be brought under full FCA regulation, with standards covering consumer protection, safeguarding, market integrity and financial resilience. Firms intending to keep operating must apply by 28 February 2027, and the new regime comes into force on 25 October 2027.

entry.title: Agenda for the First Meeting of the AI-Era On-Chain Finance Forum
entry.summary: 「AI時代を見据えたオンチェーン金融フォーラム」（第１回）議事次第 金融庁 · Sep 30, 2026 · Crypto This is the agenda for the first meeting of Japan's Financial Services Agency (FSA) "On-Chain Finance Forum for the AI Era," held on September 30, 2026. entry.title: Release of Trends in High-Speed Trading Activity (January–June 2026)
entry.summary: 高速取引行為の動向（令和８年１月～６月）の公表 金融庁 · Sep 30, 2026 The Financial Services Agency published a report on high-speed trading activity for January to June 2026, based on data from the Tokyo Stock Exchange and Osaka Exchange. entry.summary: 金融審議会「保険制度ワーキング・グループ」（第１回）議事次第 金融庁 · Sep 30, 2026 This is the agenda for the first meeting of the Insurance System Working Group under the Financial System Council of Japan's Financial Services Agency, held on October 1, 2026. entry.title: Publication of the Amendment to the Cabinet Office Ordinance Partially Revising the Banking Act Enforcement Regulations and Related Rules
entry.summary: 「銀行法施行規則等の一部を改正する内閣府令」等の公表 金融庁 · Sep 30, 2026 On September 30, 2026, the Financial Services Agency announced that the Cabinet Office Ordinance partially amending the Banking Act Enforcement Regulations and related rules had been promulgated and enforced. entry.summary: 「経済施策を一体的に講ずることによる安全保障の確保の推進に関する法律に基づく特定社会基盤事業者の指定等に関する内閣府令の一部を改正する内閣府令（案）」等の公表 金融庁 · Oct 1, 2026 The Financial Services Agency published a draft amendment to the Cabinet Office Ordinance on designating specified social infrastructure business operators under the Economic Security Promotion Act, along with related documents. Public comments are accepted until October 31, 2026.

entry.title: Results of the NISA Account Usage Survey (as of End of June 2026) Released
entry.summary: NISA口座の利用状況に関する調査結果（令和８年６月末時点）の公表 金融庁 · Oct 2, 2026 The Financial Services Agency released a summary of its survey on NISA (Nippon Individual Savings Account) account usage, covering all financial institutions that handle NISA. entry.title: Notice of the 2nd meeting of the Financial System Council's working group on how growth companies are supplied with funding
entry.summary: 金融審議会「成長企業への資金供給の在り方等に関するワーキング・グループ」（第２回）の開催 金融庁 · Oct 2, 2026 The Financial Services Agency announced the second meeting of its Financial System Council working group on funding for growth companies, to be held on October 9, 2026, from 9:00 to 11:00 at the Central Government Building No. 7, with online participation also available. entry.title: ESMA recommends changes to make MiCA clearer, safer and ready for emerging crypto services
entry.summary: ESMA calls for changes to make MiCA clearer, safer and ready for emerging services ESMA · Sep 30, 2026 · Crypto The European Securities and Markets Authority (ESMA) has responded to the European Commission's public consultation on reviewing the Markets in Crypto-Assets Regulation (MiCA). Its recommendations cover stronger investor protection, such as stricter marketing rules and cost transparency for staking, lending and borrowing, enhanced supervisory powers, clearer rules for decentralised finance and token classification, and simplification of the framework, alongside a pathway toward tokenised capital markets.

entry.title: Pantheon opens Abu Dhabi office and names regional head for Middle East
entry.summary: Pantheon expands Middle East presence with new Abu Dhabi office and senior regional appointment ADGM / FSRA · Sep 30, 2026 Pantheon, a global private markets firm with about $84bn in assets under management, has opened its first office in ADGM, Abu Dhabi's international financial centre, and appointed Firas Mallah as Managing Director and Head of Middle East. The firm says the office will deepen its relationships with investors across the GCC. The announcement is an ADGM press release.

entry.title: FSRA warns public about suspected fraudulent scheme by E-Community
entry.summary: FSRA Alerts Public to Suspected Fraudulent Scheme by E-Community ADGM / FSRA · Sep 30, 2026 The Financial Services Regulatory Authority (FSRA) of ADGM alerts the public to a suspected fraudulent scheme run by E-Community, operating from e-community.co. The FSRA says the entity makes false and misleading claims that could lead investors to believe it is licensed to operate in ADGM. The FSRA advises the market not to deal with any firm until it is verified as authentic and granted the appropriate Financial Services Permission.

entry.title: ADGM Registration Authority Releases 2026-2027 Regulatory Priorities
entry.summary: ADGM’s Registration Authority Publishes Regulatory Priorities for 2026-2027 ADGM / FSRA · Oct 1, 2026 The Registration Authority (RA) of ADGM, Abu Dhabi's international financial centre, has published its Regulatory Priorities for 2026-2027. The document outlines the areas it will focus on for monitoring, supervision and enforcement in the coming year, and how it will measure performance. It aims to improve transparency and help stakeholders understand regulatory expectations and allocate compliance resources. The priorities cover ten areas and include key performance indicators to track progress.

entry.title: Eurazeo Opens Abu Dhabi Office to Expand Its Middle East Presence
entry.summary: Eurazeo Opens an Office in Abu Dhabi, Reinforcing Its Commitment To The Middle East ADGM / FSRA · Oct 1, 2026 Eurazeo, a European private markets asset manager listed on Euronext Paris with €40 billion in assets under management, announced the opening of its first Middle East office in ADGM, Abu Dhabi's international financial centre. The office will serve as a strategic hub for the group's activities in the region and support its investor relationships and portfolio companies.

entry.title: IRS seeks volunteers and partners to support free tax preparation services
entry.summary: The IRS seeks community partners and volunteers to support free tax services IRS · Oct 1, 2026 The IRS is recruiting volunteers and community partners for its VITA and TCE programs, which provide free tax preparation for eligible taxpayers. In 2026, more than 84,500 volunteers helped file nearly 2.9 million returns at no cost. No experience is required, and the IRS provides free training; interested people can submit a sign-up form.

entry.title: Treasury and IRS propose rules for Education Freedom Tax Credit, a school choice tax credit
entry.summary: The Trump administration advances the establishment of America’s first nationwide school choice program IRS · Oct 1, 2026 The Treasury and IRS issued proposed regulations implementing section 25F, the Federal Scholarship Tax Credit, known as the Education Freedom Tax Credit. It lets taxpayers claim up to $1,700 (or $3,400 for joint filers) for contributions to scholarship-granting organizations supporting K-12 students, starting January 1, 2027. Companion temporary regulations set procedures for states and organizations to prepare.

entry.title: IRS reminder on simple steps to protect tax data during Cybersecurity Awareness Month
entry.summary: IRS reminder: Cybersecurity Awareness Month offers simple steps to protect tax data IRS · Oct 2, 2026 The IRS urges taxpayers and tax professionals to adopt simple online security habits during Cybersecurity Awareness Month. Recommended steps include strong unique passwords, multifactor authentication, software updates, caution with unexpected messages, and avoiding public Wi-Fi. The release also warns about IRS impersonation scams and lists IRS tools such as the Identity Protection PIN, and it attaches a guide for creating a Written Information Security Plan.

entry.title: CFTC Staff Extends Brexit-Related No-Action Relief
entry.summary: CFTC Staff Extends Brexit-Related No-Action Positions CFTC · Oct 1, 2026 The CFTC's Market Participants Division and Division of Market Oversight announced an extension of temporary no-action positions tied to the UK's withdrawal from the EU. The aim is to preserve regulatory certainty for derivatives trading and clearing between the UK and US. The CFTC continues working with UK authorities to analyze UK law and may issue UK comparability determinations and exemptive orders where appropriate.

entry.title: SEC proposes rule changes to widen individual investors' access to private markets
entry.summary: SEC Proposes Amendments to Expand Responsible Retailization of Private Markets SEC · Oct 1, 2026 The U.S. Securities and Exchange Commission voted to propose amendments to expand retail investor choice and encourage innovation in regulated fund structures while keeping investor protections. The proposals would let registered investment advisers receive performance-based compensation based on capital gains from clients including regulated funds, and require disclosure of such compensation in fund forms. The SEC is also seeking comment on additional ways to qualify as an accredited investor, including a FINRA-developed exam and certain professional credentials. Public comment periods remain open for 60 days after publication.

entry.title: SEC sues two men over fraud scheme targeting veterans
entry.summary: SEC Charges Two Individuals With Orchestrating Fraud Scheme That Targeted Veterans SEC · Oct 1, 2026 The SEC charged Christopher Kenji Dinelli and Jacob David Frankel with orchestrating a fraud that raised over $8.7 million from 35 investors through their fund, Beyond Alpha Ventures LLC, and advisory firm, Beyond Equity LLC. The complaint alleges they targeted veterans and medical professionals with false claims about fund performance and assets under management, and diverted investor money to losing options trades. The SEC filed its complaint in federal court in the Southern District of New York, and federal prosecutors announced parallel criminal charges.

entry.title: SEC Proposes Rules on How Investment Advisers and Funds May Custody Crypto Assets
entry.summary: SEC Proposal Would Address How Investment Advisers and Funds Can Custody Crypto Assets Under the Federal Securities Laws SEC · Oct 2, 2026 · Crypto The U.S. Securities and Exchange Commission proposed new rules and amendments providing a tailored framework for registered investment advisers and regulated funds to custody crypto assets. The proposal would permit self-custody of crypto assets under certain conditions and allow state trust companies to serve as custodians. The public comment period will remain open for 60 days after publication in the Federal Register.

entry.title: Two people plead guilty to fraud that cost four clients £2m
entry.summary: Two plead guilty after clients lose £2m in fraud case FCA · Oct 13, 2026 Two staff at financial advice firms pleaded guilty at Portsmouth Crown Court to charges brought by the FCA. They admitted defrauding clients between January 2019 and January 2023 and using false documents, causing four clients to lose £2m. One has also admitted a money laundering offence. Sentencing is set for 10 December 2026, and the FCA will seek confiscation of criminal benefit.

entry.title: Texas Stock Exchange proposes listing fees and market maker performance standards with daily stipends
entry.summary: Self-Regulatory Organizations; Texas Stock Exchange LLC; Notice of Filing and Immediate Effectiveness of a Proposed Rule Change To Adopt Listing Fees for Exchange Traded Products and Performance Standards and Daily Stipends Paid by the Exchange for Its Lead Market Maker Program Federal Register · Oct 1, 2026 · Crypto Texas Stock Exchange LLC filed a rule change with the SEC to adopt three fee tiers for exchange-traded products listed on the exchange. It also proposes three tiers of minimum performance standards for its Lead Market Maker program, with the exchange paying daily stipends to market makers that meet them. The filing says newer ETP categories are harder and costlier to make markets in, which motivates the proposal.

entry.title: Treasury interim final rule setting forms and procedures for the Stablecoin Certification Review Committee's review of state stablecoin certifications
entry.summary: Forms and Procedures for Review of State Certifications by the Stablecoin Certification Review Committee Federal Register · Sep 30, 2026 · Crypto The Treasury Department, on behalf of the Stablecoin Certification Review Committee, issued this interim final rule establishing procedural regulations and forms for the Committee to approve or deny state payment stablecoin regulators' certifications under section 4(c) of the GENIUS Act. The rule is effective September 30, 2026, but certifications will not be accepted until the information collection receives Paperwork Reduction Act approval. Comments are due by November 30, 2026.

entry.title: U.S. Treasury publishes seven Venezuela sanctions web general licenses in the Federal Register
entry.summary: Publication of Venezuela Sanctions Regulations Web General Licenses 46C, 47A, 48B, 50B, 51B, 52A, and 54A Federal Register · Sep 30, 2026 The Office of Foreign Assets Control published seven general licenses issued under the Venezuela Sanctions Regulations, which were previously posted on its website. GL 46C authorizes certain activities involving Venezuelan-origin oil and petrochemical products by established U.S. entities, subject to conditions. The licenses also exclude transactions involving persons located in several countries and certain blocked parties.

entry.title: U.S. Treasury Publishes Seven Venezuela Sanctions Web General Licenses (52–58) in Federal Register
entry.summary: Publication of Venezuela Sanctions Regulations Web General Licenses 52, 53, 54, 55, 56, 57, and 58 Federal Register · Sep 30, 2026 The Treasury's Office of Foreign Assets Control (OFAC) published in the Federal Register seven general licenses (GLs 52 through 58) issued under the Venezuela Sanctions Regulations, which had previously been posted on OFAC's website. entry.title: OFAC publishes eight Venezuela sanctions web general licenses in Federal Register
entry.summary: Publication of Venezuela Sanctions Regulations Web General Licenses 46D, 47B, 48C, 50C, 51C, 52B, 54B, and 61A Federal Register · Sep 30, 2026 The Treasury Department's Office of Foreign Assets Control published eight general licenses issued under the Venezuela Sanctions Regulations, which were previously posted on its website. entry.title: Impersonation Rule for Government and Business Scams (Advance Notice of Proposed Rulemaking)
entry.summary: Rule on Impersonation of Government and Businesses Federal Register · Oct 1, 2026 The FTC has issued an advance notice of proposed rulemaking to address search engine, social media, and other digital platforms that further government and business impersonation scams. entry.title: Final rule to make Fed stress test models and scenarios more transparent and publicly accountable
entry.summary: Enhanced Transparency and Public Accountability of the Supervisory Stress Test Models and Scenarios; Modifications to the Capital Planning and Stress Capital Buffer Requirement Rule, Enhanced Prudential Standards Rule, and Regulation LL Federal Register · Oct 2, 2026 The Federal Reserve Board adopted final amendments to Regulations Y, LL, and YY to increase transparency and public accountability of its supervisory stress testing framework, and amended related policy statements. entry.title: Federal Scholarship Tax Credit: IRS Temporary Rules for a New Credit on Scholarship Donations
entry.summary: Federal Scholarship Tax Credit Federal Register · Oct 2, 2026 The IRS issued temporary regulations implementing a new nonrefundable federal tax credit under section 25F of the Internal Revenue Code. The regulations set out requirements and procedures for states electing to participate and for organizations certified by those states, and are effective December 1, 2026.

entry.title: Federal Scholarship Tax Credit (Proposed Rules)
entry.summary: Federal Scholarship Tax Credit Federal Register · Oct 2, 2026 The IRS proposes regulations implementing a nonrefundable federal tax credit for qualified cash contributions to scholarship granting organizations that fund elementary and secondary school scholarships. Comments are due December 1, 2026, and a public hearing is scheduled for December 15, 2026.

entry.title: CFTC Secures Court Orders for Former Long Island Resident and Firm to Pay Over $288 Million in Commodity Pool Ponzi Scheme
entry.summary: CFTC Secures Federal Court Orders Requiring Former Long Island Resident and His Firm to Pay Over $288 Million for Operating a Commodity Pool Ponzi Scheme CFTC · Oct 19, 2026 · Crypto The CFTC announced that a federal court in the Southern District of New York ordered Eddy Alexandre and his company EminiFX Inc. to pay over $288 million, including $228,576,962 in restitution to defrauded investors, $15,049,500 in disgorgement of unlawful gains, and a $45,148,500 civil penalty.
