As of July 2026, over $98 million had been returned to more than 28,000 investors.

entry.title: UK capital market reform to serve the economy better (FCA speech)
entry.summary: Reforming UK capital markets to ensure they work well for our economy FCA · Oct 5, 2026 · Crypto Jon Relleen, FCA director of infrastructure and exchanges, delivered this speech at a 5 October 2026 summit on reforming UK capital market rules. He says the FCA has completed major parts of a multi-year programme aimed at supporting growth while preserving trust, market integrity and high standards. The speech cites delivered changes such as the revamped listing regime, the new public offers framework and improved bond and derivatives transparency.

entry.title: Minutes of the 57th Financial System Council General Meeting and 45th Financial Subcommittee Joint Meeting
entry.summary: 第57回金融審議会総会・第45回金融分科会合同会合議事録 金融庁 · Oct 5, 2026 · Crypto Minutes of the joint meeting held on August 31, 2026, published by the Financial Services Agency. Financial Minister Satsuki Katayama referred two questions to the Financial System Council: how to supply funds to growth companies, including flexible regulation of business lending, and the structure of insurance systems, including creating a reinsurance captive scheme and life insurance safety-net arrangements. Secretariat staff explained each item.

entry.title: Notice on the Cross-Industry Financial Cybersecurity Exercise (Delta Wall 2026)
entry.summary: 「金融業界横断的なサイバーセキュリティ演習 （Delta Wall 2026）」の実施の公表 金融庁 · Oct 5, 2026 · Crypto The Financial Services Agency will hold the 11th cross-industry cybersecurity exercise, Delta Wall 2026, from October 6 to 22, 2026, with 181 financial institutions expected to take part. The exercise aims to strengthen cyber resilience and incident response across the financial sector, including response readiness when core systems are attacked. Results will be shared with the wider industry beyond the participating institutions.

entry.title: Notice on extension of residence periods due to the 2026 Kumamoto Earthquake
entry.summary: 令和８年熊本地震に伴う在留期間の延長の公表 金融庁 · Oct 5, 2026 The Financial Services Agency announced that, following the 2026 Kumamoto Earthquake, residence periods for eligible foreign nationals in disaster-affected areas were uniformly extended to January 27, 2027 under a Ministry of Justice notice. Because residence cards still show the earlier expiry dates, concerns arose that bank accounts might be closed. The FSA asked industry associations to inform financial institutions of this extension.

entry.title: Minutes of 1st Meeting of FSA Working Group on Growth Enterprise Financing Published
entry.summary: 金融審議会「成長企業への資金供給の在り方等に関するワーキング・グループ」（第１回）議事録の公表 金融庁 · Oct 7, 2026 · Crypto The Financial Services Agency published the minutes of the first meeting of the Financial System Council's Working Group on Financing for Growth Enterprises, held on September 16, 2026. The meeting covered diversifying funding providers and restructuring money lending regulations for business loans. The Japanese Bankers Association and the Institute of International Bankers also presented.

entry.title: Public notice of names of unregistered crypto-asset exchange operators
entry.summary: 無登録で暗号資産交換業を行う者の名称等の公表 金融庁 · Oct 7, 2026 · Crypto Japan's Financial Services Agency published a list of domestic and overseas operators that conducted crypto-asset exchange business without registration and were issued warning letters, including their names, locations, business details and posting dates. The list reflects status at the time of the warning and may not show current operations or addresses, and unlisted operators may also be unregistered. Users are advised to confirm that an exchange is registered with the FSA or a Local Finance Bureau before using it.

entry.title: Status of Financial Revitalization Act disclosed claims as of March 2026
entry.summary: 令和８年３月期における金融再生法開示債権の状況等（ポイント）の公表 金融庁 · Oct 8, 2026 The Financial Services Agency published key points on the status of disclosed claims under the Financial Revitalization Act for the fiscal year ending March 2026, covering Japan's domestic banks. Total disclosed claims were 8.4 trillion yen, roughly flat year on year. Individual allowances for loan losses fell to 1.9 trillion yen, while losses from disposal of nonperforming claims rose to 0.5 trillion yen.

entry.title: Opening of Kumamoto Industrial Recovery Consultation Center and Establishment of Kumamoto Earthquake 2026 Recovery Support Fund
entry.summary: 「熊本産業復興相談センター」の開設及び「令和８年熊本地震復興支援ファンド」の設立について（令和８年熊本地震による被災事業者の多重債務問題対応）の公表 金融庁 · Oct 9, 2026 The Kumamoto Industrial Recovery Consultation Center opened on October 9, 2026 at the Kumamoto Chamber of Commerce and Industry to provide consultations, including working capital support, to businesses affected by the 2026 Kumamoto Earthquake. The Organization for Small & Medium Enterprises and Regional Economy Revitalization Corporation of Japan (REVIC), together with regional financial institutions, are establishing a fund of up to 5 billion yen to address multiple-debt problems faced by affected businesses.

entry.title: Update to the special page on information related to the 2024 Noto Peninsula Earthquake (as of 10:00, October 9, 2026)
entry.summary: 令和６年能登半島地震関連情報に関する特設ページの更新（令和８年10月９日 10時00分時点） 金融庁 · Oct 9, 2026 Japan's Financial Services Agency has updated its special page on the 2024 Noto Peninsula Earthquake. It compiles information on financial institutions' operating status in affected areas, support schemes such as debt restructuring for housing loans, insurance inquiry services, donation transfer fees, and fraud warnings. The page also lists the operating status of bank branches and ATMs in the Noto area of Ishikawa Prefecture.

entry.title: Japan FSA Alert on Strengthened Cybersecurity Measures and Handling of Transaction Applications
entry.summary: 現下の情勢を踏まえたサイバーセキュリティ対策の強化と各種取引申込等における対応の公表 金融庁 · Oct 9, 2026 On October 9, 2026, Japan's Financial Services Agency issued an alert to financial institutions after unauthorized access incidents led to leaks of customer information, including images of driver's licenses and other identity documents. It asks institutions to review cybersecurity measures, including third-party risk management and incident response, and to carefully check document and facial images in non-face-to-face identity verification. It also urges prompt action toward the April 1, 2027 amendment that will generally limit identity verification to reading IC chip information.

entry.title: FSA administrative sanctions on Prudential Life, Gibraltar Life and Prudential Holdings of Japan
entry.summary: プルデンシャル生命保険株式会社、ジブラルタ生命保険株式会社及びプルデンシャル・ホールディング・オブ・ジャパン株式会社に対する行政処分の公表 金融庁 · Oct 9, 2026 On October 9, 2026, Japan's Financial Services Agency announced administrative sanctions against Prudential Life Insurance, Gibraltar Life Insurance and Prudential Holdings of Japan under the Insurance Business Act. The orders suspend insurance solicitation and contract signing from October 13, 2026 to January 31, 2027, and require business improvement, including sales-force management reforms and an improvement plan with periodic progress reports.

entry.title: Agenda of the 14th Transition Finance Environment Development Study Group
entry.summary: 「トランジション・ファイナンス環境整備検討会」（第14回）議事次第の公表 金融庁 · Oct 9, 2026 This is the agenda published by the Financial Services Agency for the 14th meeting of the Transition Finance Environment Development Study Group, held on August 21, 2026. Topics include domestic and international trends in transition finance and a draft revision of the basic guidelines for Climate Transition Finance, which is not public. The page also lists members and the organizers (FSA, METI, Ministry of the Environment).

entry.title: Minutes of the 14th Transition Finance Environment Development Study Group Meeting
entry.summary: 「トランジション・ファイナンス環境整備検討会」（第14回）議事要旨の公表 金融庁 · Oct 9, 2026 The Financial Services Agency of Japan published the minutes of the 14th meeting of the Transition Finance Environment Development Study Group, held on August 21, 2026. The meeting discussed domestic and international trends in transition finance and a revision of the Climate Transition Finance Basic Guidelines, which was not made public. Members commented on developments related to the SFDR, the role of the transition finance subsidy program, and trends in ASEAN.

entry.title: Notice of decision finding no violation in insider trading by an overseas resident who received information from an employee of a Demae-can contract negotiator
entry.summary: （株）出前館との契約締結交渉者の従業員から伝達を受けた海外居住者による内部者取引に対する違反事実がないと認める旨の決定の公表 金融庁 · Oct 9, 2026 The Financial Services Agency announced a decision, based on a draft submitted by the examiners, that the respondent's conduct cannot be found to constitute the violation listed in Article 178(1)(xvi) of the Financial Instruments and Exchange Act. The case began with a surcharge recommendation from the Securities and Exchange Surveillance Commission, and proceedings opened on January 24, 2025.

entry.title: Warning about unauthorized access and trades on online brokerage services
entry.summary: 「インターネット取引サービスへの不正アクセス・不正取引にご注意ください」のページの更新 金融庁 · Oct 9, 2026 The Financial Services Agency updated its warning page on unauthorized access and unauthorized trading in online brokerage services. Criminals use phishing sites imitating securities firms to steal customer login credentials, then sell stocks in victims' accounts and buy small-cap shares. The page lists monthly provisional figures on incidents and offers prevention tips and FSA consultation contact details.

entry.title: ESMA clarifies EU market access to third-country CSD services
entry.summary: ESMA clarifies access for EU market participants to the services of third-country CSDs ESMA · Oct 7, 2026 ESMA has issued a statement saying EU market participants should not be blocked from third-country Central Securities Depositories after the transitional regime ends on 17 January 2027, until EU legislation extending it is finalised. The Council and European Parliament both support the extension under the Market Integration and Supervision Package. ESMA expects national competent authorities not to prioritise supervisory or enforcement action against unrecognised third-country CSDs until the extension takes effect.

entry.title: ESMA sets supervisory expectations for services linked to non-MiCA-compliant stablecoins
entry.summary: ESMA sets out supervisory expectations on services related to unauthorised stablecoins ESMA · Oct 8, 2026 · Crypto The European Securities and Markets Authority (ESMA) has issued an opinion clarifying its supervisory expectations for crypto-asset services involving asset-referenced tokens and e-money tokens, known as stablecoins, that do not comply with MiCA. It states that MiCA-authorised crypto-asset service providers should stop providing such services to EU clients. National competent authorities should require remediation of any remaining exposures no later than three months after publication.

entry.title: ESMA seeks evidence on using tokenised collateral in central clearing
entry.summary: ESMA seeks evidence on the use of tokenised collateral in central clearing ESMA · Oct 9, 2026 · Crypto The European Securities and Markets Authority (ESMA) has launched a Call for Evidence on whether EU central counterparties (CCPs) could safely use tokenised collateral, with responses due by 15 January 2027. The paper examines how tokenisation may affect the transfer, management, protection and use of collateral across its lifecycle, including after a clearing member default. ESMA will assess the feedback in the first quarter of 2027.

entry.title: Carlo Comporti named new Chair of ESMA
entry.summary: Carlo Comporti appointed Chair of the European Securities and Markets Authority ESMA · Oct 9, 2026 The European Securities and Markets Authority (ESMA) has announced that Carlo Comporti has been appointed as its next Chair, confirmed by the Council of the European Union. He takes up the position on 1 November 2026. Current Chair Verena Ross welcomed him and reflected on her five years leading the authority. Comporti previously served as a Commissioner at Italy's CONSOB and as a member of ESMA's Board of Supervisors and Management Board.

entry.title: ESMA Appoints Carlos San Basilio to Its Management Board
entry.summary: ESMA appoints Carlos San Basilio as the new member of its Management Board ESMA · Oct 9, 2026 The European Securities and Markets Authority has appointed Carlos San Basilio of Spain's CNMV as a new member of its Management Board. He replaces Carlo Comporti of Italy's CONSOB, who steps down to become ESMA Chair effective 1 November. The election took place at the Board of Supervisors meeting in Paris on 6 October 2026. The Management Board, chaired by the ESMA Chair, ensures the Authority fulfils its mission under its founding Regulation.

entry.title: CSRC seeks public comment on draft revised rules for public fund operations
entry.summary: 中国证监会就《公开募集证券投资基金运作管理办法（征求意见稿）》及配套规则公开征求意见 中国证监会 · Oct 9, 2026 The China Securities Regulatory Commission released draft revisions to its public securities investment fund operations rules and related regulations for public comment. The revisions aim to strengthen fund manager responsibilities, support equity funds, and improve operational flexibility by optimizing some regulatory indicators and mechanisms.

entry.title: CSRC Holds Expert Symposium on Capital Markets and Financial Conditions
entry.summary: 中国证监会召开资本市场和金融形势专家座谈会 中国证监会 · Oct 10, 2026 On October 10, 2026, CSRC Chairman Wu Qing held a symposium in Beijing with listed company executives and securities and fund experts to discuss current capital market and financial conditions. Participants agreed the markets are operating steadily and proposed measures including stronger market stabilization mechanisms, broader long-term capital inflows, more dividends and buybacks, improved listing rules, and enhanced trading and cross-border risk monitoring.

entry.title: ADGM FSRA Seeks Industry Feedback on Proposed DeFi Risk Management Guidance
entry.summary: ADGM FSRA Invites Industry Feedback on Proposed DeFi Risk Management Guidance ADGM / FSRA · Oct 6, 2026 · Crypto The ADGM Financial Services Regulatory Authority (FSRA) has published a consultation paper seeking feedback on proposed guidance for managing risks from decentralised finance (DeFi) engagement. The guidance sets out expectations for how authorised persons and recognised bodies should identify, assess, monitor and manage DeFi-related risks. It covers governance, due diligence, financial crime controls, incident escalation, and client asset safeguards. Comments are due by 30 November 2026 and may be sent to fsra.consultation@adgm.com.

entry.title: Capital Group Secures FSRA Licence in Abu Dhabi to Expand Middle East Presence
entry.summary: Capital Group secures FSRA licence in Abu Dhabi as it expands in the Middle East ADGM / FSRA · Oct 7, 2026 Capital Group, a major active investment manager, has received a Financial Services Permission from the Financial Services Regulatory Authority (FSRA) of ADGM, allowing it to operate as a regulated investment manager in ADGM. The permission covers trading, investment management and distribution activities. It follows the firm's May 2026 announcement of plans to open its first Middle East office in Abu Dhabi.

entry.title: New Mountain Capital Opens Abu Dhabi Office in ADGM to Deepen Regional Presence
entry.summary: New Mountain Capital Opens Abu Dhabi Office in ADGM, Strengthening Long-Term Commitment to the Region ADGM / FSRA · Oct 7, 2026 New York-based investment firm New Mountain Capital announced it has established New Mountain Capital Middle East Limited in Abu Dhabi's ADGM after receiving approval from the FSRA to conduct regulated activities. The office, led by Shehreyar Hameed as Senior Executive Officer, aims to strengthen client relationships and grow its investor base in the GCC region. The firm states its investments will remain focused on defensive-growth middle-market companies in North America.

entry.title: IRS highlights partnership with UK tax authority's new whistleblower program
entry.summary: IRS highlights partnership with UK tax authority’s new whistleblower program IRS · Oct 7, 2026 The IRS highlighted its partnership with HMRC's Strengthened Reward Scheme, a whistleblower program launched in November 2025 that drew on IRS Whistleblower Office expertise. The program encourages reports of serious tax avoidance and evasion by the wealthiest individuals and largest businesses. Both agencies say the collaboration will help deter large-scale cross-border tax evasion.

entry.title: Taxpayers won't be penalised for inaccurate income data from intermediaries
entry.summary: Taxpayers won’t be penalised because of inaccurate details submitted by intermediaries IRAS · Oct 5, 2026 The Inland Revenue Authority of Singapore (IRAS) responded to a reader letter, stating that under its pre-filling of income initiative for platform workers, taxpayers will not be penalised if assessments must be revised due to incomplete or inaccurate income information submitted by intermediaries, who are responsible for accuracy. For the Grab case, Grab has submitted corrected income records, and IRAS is revising affected private-hire car drivers' assessments and will issue revised tax bills, requiring no action from drivers beforehand.

entry.title: ADGM Registration Authority Consults on Enhanced Strata Regulations
entry.summary: ADGM Registration Authority Publishes Consultation Paper on Enhanced Strata Regulations 07 Oct 2026 ADGM / FSRA · Oct 7, 2026 The ADGM Registration Authority has issued a consultation paper proposing new strata regulations to repeal and replace the Strata Title Regulations 2015. Key proposals include automatic formation of an Owners' Association, appointment of licensed Owners' Association Managers, Registrar approval of annual budgets, and duties to report material defects. The consultation closes on 22 October 2026.

entry.title: Numou and Comera Financial Holding partner to expand financing and payment options for UAE SMEs
entry.summary: Numou and Comera Financial Holding Partner to Expand Financing and Payment Solutions for UAE SMEs 07 Oct 2026 ADGM / FSRA · Oct 7, 2026 Numou, an ADGM subsidiary, and Comera Financial Holding, part of Abu Dhabi's Royal Group, have signed a partnership agreement. Comera's financial products and services will be added to Numou's digital marketplace, giving SMEs more options for financing, business account opening and digital payments. The collaboration covers working capital, supply chain finance and payment solutions.

entry.title: FSRA warns public about false and misleading claims by Takeo Investments
entry.summary: FSRA Alerts Public to False and Misleading claims made by Takeo Investments 08 Oct 2026 ADGM / FSRA · Oct 8, 2026 The FSRA of ADGM warns that Takeo Investments made false and misleading claims, including a possible false association with ADGM. Its former website is no longer operational. The FSRA is concerned these claims could lead investors to believe the firm is licensed to operate in ADGM when it is not. The public is advised to verify any firm on the FSRA Public Register before dealing with it.

entry.title: ADGM FSRA Consults on Revisions to Fees and General Rulebooks
entry.summary: ADGM FSRA Launches Consultation on Revisions to its Fees and General Rulebooks 09 Oct 2026 ADGM / FSRA · Oct 9, 2026 The ADGM Financial Services Regulatory Authority has published Consultation Paper No. 6 of 2026, proposing amendments to its Fees Rulebook and General Rulebook. The proposals update fees for Recognised Bodies and operators of MTFs and OTFs, introduce a supervision fee for securities on the Official List, and increase the late Regulatory Filing fee. The consultation closes on 6 November 2026.

entry.title: ADGM regulator fines PKF Accountants and its audit principal USD 100,000 over audit failings
entry.summary: ADGM’s Registration Authority Imposes Financial Penalties of USD 100,000 against PKF Accountants and its Registered Audit Principal for Audit Failings 09 Oct 2026 ADGM / FSRA · Oct 9, 2026 The ADGM Registration Authority fined PKF Accountants and Business Advisers LLP and its registered audit principal, Ms Saranga Omprakash Lalwani, a combined USD 100,000 for audit failings. An on-site inspection found the audit was not conducted and reported under International Standards on Auditing and lacked due skill, care and diligence. The RA said it will maintain high audit quality standards in ADGM.

entry.title: CFTC Seeks Comment on Proposed Rules for Crypto Asset Transactions and Markets
entry.summary: CFTC Seeks Public Comment on Advanced Notice of Proposed Rulemaking Relating to Regulation Crypto Asset Transactions and Regulation Crypto Asset Markets CFTC · Oct 6, 2026 · Crypto The U.S. Commodity Futures Trading Commission published an Advanced Notice of Proposed Rulemaking signaling its intent to build a comprehensive framework for retail crypto asset commodity transactions (CTXs) under section 2(c)(2)(D) of the Commodity Exchange Act. The notice seeks comment on preventing abusive practices, sharing industry best practices, and codifying a designated contract market subcategory called a crypto asset market. Written comments are due within 60 days of Federal Register publication.

entry.title: CFTC Issues No-Action Letter Allowing Perpetual-Style Index Futures to Become True Perpetuals
entry.summary: CFTC Issues No-Action Letter for DCMs Regarding Converting Existing Perpetual-Style Broad-Based Security Index Futures into True Perpetual Futures CFTC · Oct 6, 2026 The CFTC's Division of Market Oversight has issued no-action relief letting designated contract markets convert existing perpetual-style broad-based security index futures into true perpetual futures. Conversion takes effect once customer protection and procedural conditions are met, including soliciting feedback from open-position holders, giving advance notice and an exit opportunity, providing risk disclosures, and leaving other material terms unchanged. The no-action positions expire on October 20, 2026.

entry.title: CFTC issues interim final rule excluding certain gambling activity from the swap definition
entry.summary: CFTC Issues Interim Final Rule Excluding Certain Activity from the Definition of Swap CFTC · Oct 10, 2026 The Commodity Futures Trading Commission published an interim final rule codifying that casino-style gambling products, including sportsbook and casino game wagers, are excluded from the definition of "swap." The rule takes effect upon publication in the Federal Register. Written comments must be submitted via Regulations.gov within 30 days of that publication.

entry.title: CFTC seeks comment on proposal to define certain event contracts as swaps
entry.summary: CFTC Seeks Public Comment on Notice of Proposed Rulemaking Concerning the Inclusion of Certain Event Contracts in the Definition of Swap CFTC · Oct 10, 2026 The U.S. Commodity Futures Trading Commission published a proposed rule that would expressly include event contracts, such as those based on sports, politics, culture, and weather, within the definition of “swap.” The proposal says these contracts are commonly known as swaps and aims to resolve any ambiguity. Written comments must be submitted via Regulations.gov within 30 days of Federal Register publication.

entry.title: SEC Joins Global Regulators to Promote Fraud Awareness During World Investor Week
entry.summary: SEC Coordinates with Global Financial Regulators to Raise Fraud Awareness During World Investor Week SEC · Oct 5, 2026 The SEC, with other U.S. and global financial regulators, issued a joint investor bulletin as part of World Investor Week. It urges investors to stay resilient amid changing economic conditions and to watch for rising relationship investment and impersonation scams. The initiative, led by IOSCO, marks its tenth anniversary this year.

entry.title: SEC Announces Virtual Compliance Seminar for Investment Companies and Advisers
entry.summary: SEC to Host Virtual National Compliance Outreach Seminar for Investment Companies and Investment Advisers SEC · Oct 6, 2026 The SEC's Compliance Outreach Program will host a free virtual national seminar for investment companies and investment advisers on November 19, 2026. It aims to help chief compliance officers and senior staff strengthen compliance programs to protect investors. Panels cover information security, adviser and fund topics, compliance program effectiveness, and current issues. No advance registration is required, and the webcast link will be posted on SEC.gov that morning.

entry.title: SEC seeks final judgment against former Western Asset co-CIO Ken Leech in cherry-picking case
entry.summary: SEC Seeks Final Judgment Against Former Western Asset Co-CIO Ken Leech in Cherry Picking Case SEC · Oct 7, 2026 The SEC moved on October 6, 2026, for a consent-based final judgment against Stephen Kenneth Leech II, former co-CIO of Western Asset Management, over an alleged cherry-picking scheme. The SEC alleges that from January 2021 through October 2023 Leech allocated first-day gains to favored portfolios and first-day losses to disfavored ones. Without admitting the allegations, Leech consented to a judgment, subject to court approval, requiring a $3 million penalty, an officer-and-director bar, and a permanent injunction against antifraud violations.

entry.title: SEC Proposes Expanding Securities Eligible for Cross Trading by Registered Funds
entry.summary: SEC Proposes Expanding Securities Eligible for Cross Trading by Registered Funds SEC · Oct 9, 2026 The SEC proposed amendments to the Investment Company Act cross-trading rule (Rule 17a-7) that would let registered funds cross trade more securities with affiliates, including most fixed-income securities. The changes would also modernize the rule's conditions and require aggregated reporting of trading activity and cross trades on Forms N-PORT and N-MFP. Comments are due on or before December 14, 2026.

entry.title: FCA reviews how it engages with whistleblowers
entry.summary: Looking at how we interact with whistleblowers FCA · Oct 6, 2026 The UK Financial Conduct Authority (FCA) mourns the death of a whistleblower it had long been in contact with and outlines how it works with whistleblowers. Of the 1,252 whistleblowing reports closed last year, 42% led to direct action to manage or reduce harm, and 53% informed wider work and harm prevention. The FCA has asked new independent non-executive director Lea Paterson to review its interactions with this whistleblower and plans to share lessons early next year.

entry.title: UK FCA proposes notice periods for long-term investment fund redemptions
entry.summary: New rules to make long-term investment funds clearer FCA · Oct 8, 2026 The FCA has set out clearer expectations for asset managers investing in long-term assets such as property. Under the proposed rules, investors would need to give 90 days' notice to access their funds. Existing funds would have 2 years to comply and must give investors at least 1 year's notice. Feedback on the proposals is requested by 11 December 2026.

entry.title: Strong compliance functions help keep corporate finance markets trusted
entry.summary: Strong compliance functions support trusted corporate finance markets FCA · Oct 8, 2026 · Crypto The UK FCA reports findings from a survey of 411 corporate finance firms on their compliance functions, receiving 382 responses. Most firms carry out key compliance activities, but gaps remain in areas such as whistleblowing arrangements, breach registers and performance assessment. The FCA asks firms to reflect on their arrangements and says it will engage further with selected firms.

entry.title: Liam Coleman appointed chair of the Financial Ombudsman Service, which resolves financial complaints
entry.summary: Liam Coleman appointed as chair of the Financial Ombudsman Service FCA · Oct 9, 2026 The FCA Board has appointed Liam Coleman as permanent chair of the Financial Ombudsman Service, with Treasury approval. He takes up the role on 10 October 2026 for a 3-year term, having served as interim chair for the past year. The service resolves complaints between financial businesses and their customers.

entry.title: Building the future of finance in the age of AI
entry.summary: Building the future of finance in the age of AI FCA · Oct 19, 2026 A drafted speech by FCA chief data, information and intelligence officer Jessica Rusu at Bloomberg's UK Policy Series, which may differ from the delivered version. It sets out the FCA's approach to the safe and responsible adoption of AI in financial services, including its response to the Mills Review. It also covers clearer disclaimers for consumers and examples of good and poor AI practice.

entry.title: Economic Secretary's UK Digital Assets Week speech on digitising financial markets
entry.summary: Economic Secretary to the Treasury speech for UK Digital Assets Week HMRC / gov.uk · Oct 6, 2026 · Crypto The Economic Secretary to the Treasury gave a speech at UK Digital Assets Week setting out the government's ambition to lead globally in digital assets. The speech cites the Wholesale Financial Markets Digital Strategy, the appointment of a Wholesale Digital Markets Champion, and approvals for HSBC and ClearToken to operate Digital Securities Depositories in the Digital Securities Sandbox. It also outlines a pilot issuance of the Digital Gilt Instrument (DIGIT) planned for the first quarter of 2027.

entry.title: Basel Committee revises G-SIB assessment framework to curb window dressing and seeks comment on methodology review
entry.summary: 国際関係,バーゼル銀行監督委員会による「グローバルなシステム上重要な銀行（G-SIB）－ウィンドウ・ドレッシング行動に対処するための評価枠組みの改訂」及び市中協議文書「G-SIB評価手法のレビュー」について公表しました。 金融庁 · Oct 23, 2026 Not enough source text for a summary

entry.title: Public comment request on MCC program reporting and NCUA proposed Call Report revisions
entry.summary: Proposed Agency Information Collection Activities; Comment Request Federal Register · Oct 9, 2026 · Crypto This notice seeks public comment on two proposed federal information collections. The first describes how the Millennium Challenge Corporation (MCC) gathers reporting and data to assess compact performance, publishing quarterly status summaries and Star Reports for completed compacts. The second proposes revising the National Credit Union Administration's Call Report (Form 5300) to collect data on credit unions' payment stablecoin activities, effective with the March 31, 2027 report date. Comments are due by December 8, 2026.

entry.title: SEC Order Approving OCC Rule Change on Allocating Clearing Fund Deposits Among Clearing Members
entry.summary: Self-Regulatory Organizations; The Options Clearing Corporation; Order Setting Aside Action by Delegated Authority and Approving Proposed Rule Change, as Modified by Partial Amendment No. 1, by The Options Clearing Corporation Concerning Methodology To Allocate Clearing Fund Deposit Requirements Among Its Clearing Members To Better Align the Allocation With the Sizing of the Clearing Fund so Stress Based Risk is Fairly Allotted to Market Participants That Expose OCC to Such Stress Risk Federal Register · Oct 6, 2026 The Securities and Exchange Commission issued an order setting aside a prior action taken by delegated authority and approving a proposed rule change by The Options Clearing Corporation (OCC). The change concerns how clearing fund deposit requirements are allocated among clearing members, aiming to better align the allocation with the clearing fund's size. The goal is to fairly allot stress-based risk to market participants that expose OCC to such risk. The document also describes the related comment and review procedures.

entry.title: Withdrawal of Proposed Special Measure on Crypto Mixing as a Money Laundering Concern
entry.summary: Proposal of Special Measure Regarding Convertible Virtual Currency Mixing, as a Class of Transactions of Primary Money Laundering Concern; Withdrawal Federal Register · Oct 6, 2026 · Crypto FinCEN is withdrawing its earlier finding and proposed rule under Section 311 of the USA PATRIOT Act. That proposal had treated international convertible virtual currency mixing as a class of transactions of primary money laundering concern and sought enhanced recordkeeping and reporting requirements. The original proposal was published at 88 FR 72701 on October 23, 2023, and the withdrawal takes effect October 6, 2026.

entry.title: Proposed rule withdrawal on reporting, recordkeeping and identity verification for certain convertible virtual currency or digital asset transactions
entry.summary: Requirements for Certain Transactions Involving Convertible Virtual Currency or Digital Assets; Withdrawal Federal Register · Oct 6, 2026 · Crypto FinCEN is withdrawing a 2020 proposed rule that would have required banks and money service businesses to report, keep records, and verify customer identities for transactions involving convertible virtual currency or digital assets held in unhosted wallets or wallets hosted in a FinCEN-identified jurisdiction. The agency states it will take no further action on this proposal.

entry.title: SEC Proposes Adviser and Regulated Fund Custody Rules and Crypto Custody Rules
entry.summary: Adviser and Regulated Fund Custody Rules; Crypto Custody Rules Federal Register · Oct 6, 2026 · Crypto The Securities and Exchange Commission proposes new custody rules for regulated investment companies to hold crypto securities and similar investments, and amendments for registered investment advisers to custody client crypto funds and securities. entry.title: Treasury Request for OMB Review of U.S. Information Return Forms and Related Guidance Collection
entry.summary: Agency Information Collection Activities; Submission for OMB Review; Comment Request; U.S. Information Returns and Related Forms, Schedules, Attachments, and Published Guidance Federal Register · Oct 23, 2026 · Crypto The U.S. Department of the Treasury is submitting an information collection covering U.S. information returns, such as Forms 1099 and 1098, along with related forms, schedules, attachments, and published guidance, to the Office of Management and Budget for review. The notice explains how the Paperwork Reduction Act approval and burden estimates apply to this collection. The public may submit comments by November 23, 2026.

entry.title: Outbound Investment Security Program Regulations (proposed rule)
entry.summary: Outbound Investment Security Program Regulations Federal Register · Oct 26, 2026 The Treasury Department proposes regulations to implement Subtitle C of the Comprehensive Outbound Investment National Security Act, codified in Title VIII of the Defense Production Act. The rule would require U.S. persons to notify Treasury of certain transactions with foreign persons engaged in notifiable technologies, and prohibit certain other transactions with foreign persons engaged in prohibited technologies. It also adds applicability dates so the regulations continue to cover activities within the relevant timeframe. Comments are due December 7, 2026.
